description: This file defines a Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for ReceiptDocument objects, including custom query methods based on user ID, category, vendor, and transaction date range.

classes.name: ReceiptDocumentRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing ReceiptDocument entities in MongoDB; extends MongoRepository and provides custom query methods.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of receipt documents for a specific user ID.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndCategoryContainingIgnoreCaseAndVendorContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of receipt documents filtered by user ID, category, and vendor with case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: findByTransactionDateBetween
methods.description: Finds all receipt documents with transaction dates within the specified start and end instants.
